method: Unchanged World (ahb) over a LinkedHashMap provider of real Chunk (apx) objects in chunks -3..3 (x, z -48..63). Each scenario replays ops: queue n (World.lightUpdateBlockList = new int[n]), gen cx cz (new Chunk from the fills over air, then generateSkylightMap), load cx cz (gen, then Chunk.populateChunk(provider, provider, cx, cz) where the provider populate is ChunkProviderServer.populate: func_150809_p, then the chunk decoration list through World.setBlock flag 2; a decoration at x, z belongs to chunk ((x - 8) >> 4, (z - 8) >> 4)), terrain (isTerrainPopulated on every loaded chunk), tick (per loaded chunk in load order: enqueueRelightChecks then func_150804_b(false), isRemote false), reset (resetRelightChecks on every loaded chunk), set x y z id meta (World.setBlock flag 2, isRemote true), snap label (sha256 of World.getSavedLightValue sky bytes and block bytes over x, z -48..63 and y 0..255, x-major then z then y, and World.getHeightValue big-endian shorts in the same column order; unloaded chunks read sky 15, block 0, height 0). Fills are x0,y0,z0,x1,y1,z1,id,meta; decorations x,y,z,id,meta in order.
